confidence_notes: Medium confidence: holistic estimates from general knowledge of Melbourne pricing, not checked against live menus or listings. Cafe and restaurant anchors are better grounded than accommodation, which varies by season and events; July is treated as an off-peak winter month. Cocktail and wine_glass are estimated from general bar and restaurant pricing and cross-checked against the beer anchor. FX came from web-search summaries of rba.gov.au exchange-rate pages showing the 15 Oct 2026 4.00pm reading; the F11.1 file itself was not opened, and some cached RBA copies showed conflicting dates, so verify against the live table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Basis is general knowledge of Melbourne CBD and inner-suburb prices, loosely benchmarked against other large Australian capital cities such as Sydney, with July accommodation demand treated as off-peak.
